text.p: President Clinton Tuesday announced a series of staff changes, including naming political consultant Paul Begala and ex-journalist Sidney Blumenthal to communications posts at the White House.
Begala, a key political consultant in Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign, was named counsellor to the president for communications and strategy. He has been teaching at the University of Texas.
Blumenthal, who worked for The New Yorker magazine, the New Republic and the Washington Post, will serve as assistant to the president for communications strategy and special projects.

Clinton also elevated Michael Waldman, his director of speechwriting, to be an assistant to the president. He also promoted speechwriter J. Terry Edmonds to deputy director of the speechwriting staff.
Clinton also promoted Stephanie Streett to become assistant to the president and director of presidential scheduling.
